title: EverydayScience BeverageCooling

stats.done_summary: Completed the analysis of the beverage cooling data. Identified three distinct cooling segments separated by sudden temperature jumps at t=80 and t=121. Fitted Newton's Law of Cooling to the data, comparing models with constant/variable cooling constants (k) and environmental temperatures (T_env). Found that a model with a constant k (0.01155 min^-1) and variable T_env (25 C, 34 C, 25 C) perfectly describes the data (R^2 = 1.0). Generated plots of the fit and residuals, and wrote a comprehensive report detailing the methodology, results, and physical interpretation of the findings.
